summary: Role that determines the level of environmental review for proposed actions, prepares or directs effects analyses, coordinates cooperating agencies and consultations, builds the administrative record and writes decision documents under the governing agency procedures. AI drafting compresses production; verification, record integrity and litigation resilience grow.
evidenceNotice: Reshaping claims are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). No task has a v2 multi-rater assessment yet, so every task shows 'assessment pending'. Change indicators count active signals only (ADR-0028); all linked signals are at watch, so no change indicator moves. v1 values appear only as prior-evidence pointers.
